---
title: "Network Plots"
format: html
---

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(here)

# Load theme configuration
source(here("R", "theme_config.R"))

# Tuning knobs
MIN_LABEL_DEG_SOURCE <- 1L
MIN_LABEL_DEG_DATASET <- 1L
```

## Data Loading

```{r load-processed-data}
# Load resolved lineage links computed in 01_data_prep.qmd
links <- read_csv(here("data", "processed", "network_links.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    mutate(dataset_group = factor(dataset_group, levels = names(category_colors)))

if (nrow(links) == 0) {
    stop("No lineage links found. Run 01_data_prep.qmd first.")
}
```

## Node and Graph Construction

```{r graph-construction}
# Build source and dataset leaf nodes
source_nodes <- links |>
    distinct(input_type, source) |>
    arrange(input_type, source) |>
    mutate(
        node_id = paste0("src::", input_type, "::", source),
        label = source,
        node_kind = "source"
    )

dataset_nodes <- links |>
    distinct(dataset, dataset_group) |>
    arrange(dataset_group, dataset) |>
    mutate(
        node_id = paste0("ds::", dataset),
        label = dataset,
        node_kind = "dataset"
    )

# Connection edges (lineage links to bundle)
conn_edges <- links |>
    left_join(source_nodes |> select(input_type, source, from = node_id), by = c("input_type", "source")) |>
    left_join(dataset_nodes |> select(dataset, to = node_id), by = "dataset") |>
    distinct(from, to, input_type)

# Hierarchy tree for edge bundling
hier_edges <- list()
vertices <- list()

vertices[[length(vertices) + 1]] <- tibble(
    name = "branch::inputs", node_kind = "branch", input_type = NA_character_,
    dataset_group = NA_character_, label = "Inputs", is_leaf = FALSE
)

vertices[[length(vertices) + 1]] <- tibble(
    name = "branch::datasets", node_kind = "branch", input_type = NA_character_,
    dataset_group = NA_character_, label = "Datasets", is_leaf = FALSE
)

# Connect top branches
hier_edges[[length(hier_edges) + 1]] <- tibble(from = "branch::inputs", to = "branch::datasets")

dataset_groups <- dataset_nodes |>
    distinct(dataset_group) |>
    arrange(dataset_group) |>
    pull(dataset_group)

for (grp in dataset_groups) {
    grp_id <- paste0("dgroup::", grp)
    vertices[[length(vertices) + 1]] <- tibble(
        name = grp_id, node_kind = "branch", input_type = NA_character_,
        dataset_group = grp, label = grp, is_leaf = FALSE
    )
    hier_edges[[length(hier_edges) + 1]] <- tibble(from = "branch::datasets", to = grp_id)

    grp_sets <- dataset_nodes |> filter(dataset_group == grp)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(grp_sets))) {
        hier_edges[[length(hier_edges) + 1]] <- tibble(from = grp_id, to = grp_sets$node_id[i])
        vertices[[length(vertices) + 1]] <- tibble(
            name = grp_sets$node_id[i], node_kind = "dataset", input_type = NA_character_,
            dataset_group = grp, label = grp_sets$label[i], is_leaf = TRUE
        )
    }
}

for (tp in c("Remotely Sensed", "In Situ & Survey Data")) {
    type_id <- paste0("type::", tp)
    vertices[[length(vertices) + 1]] <- tibble(
        name = type_id, node_kind = "branch", input_type = tp,
        dataset_group = NA_character_, label = tp, is_leaf = FALSE
    )
    hier_edges[[length(hier_edges) + 1]] <- tibble(from = "branch::inputs", to = type_id)

    type_sources <- source_nodes |> filter(input_type == tp)
    if (nrow(type_sources) > 0) {
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(type_sources))) {
            hier_edges[[length(hier_edges) + 1]] <- tibble(from = type_id, to = type_sources$node_id[i])
            vertices[[length(vertices) + 1]] <- tibble(
                name = type_sources$node_id[i], node_kind = "source", input_type = tp,
                dataset_group = NA_character_, label = type_sources$label[i], is_leaf = TRUE
            )
        }
    }
}

hierarchy <- bind_rows(hier_edges)
vertices_df <- bind_rows(vertices) |> distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE)

deg_tbl <- tibble(name = c(conn_edges$from, conn_edges$to)) |>
    count(name, name = "degree")

d_groups <- dataset_nodes |>
    distinct(dataset_group) |>
    pull()
pal_ds <- category_colors[d_groups]
pal_ds[is.na(pal_ds)] <- bundle_palette["node_default"]
names(pal_ds) <- d_groups

vertices_df <- vertices_df |>
    left_join(deg_tbl, by = "name") |>
    mutate(degree = replace_na(degree, 0L))

# Create and activate tidygraph object
tg <- tbl_graph(nodes = vertices_df, edges = hierarchy, directed = TRUE) |>
    activate(nodes) |>
    mutate(
        node_color = case_when(
            node_kind == "source" & input_type == "Remotely Sensed" ~ bundle_palette["Remotely Sensed"],
            node_kind == "source" & input_type == "In Situ & Survey Data" ~ bundle_palette["In Situ & Survey Data"],
            node_kind == "dataset" ~ pal_ds[dataset_group],
            TRUE ~ bundle_palette["node_default"]
        ),
        pretty_label = case_when(
            node_kind == "source" & degree >= MIN_LABEL_DEG_SOURCE ~ label,
            node_kind == "dataset" & degree >= MIN_LABEL_DEG_DATASET ~ label,
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
    )
```

## Layout Adjustments

```{r layout-adjustments}
lay <- create_layout(tg, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE)

leaf_src <- lay |> filter(is_leaf & node_kind == "source")
leaf_ds <- lay |> filter(is_leaf & node_kind == "dataset")

lay$angle <- NA_real_
lay$angle[lay$name %in% leaf_ds$name] <- seq(80, -80, length.out = nrow(leaf_ds))
lay$angle[lay$name %in% leaf_src$name] <- seq(100, 260, length.out = nrow(leaf_src))

r <- max(sqrt(lay$x^2 + lay$y^2), na.rm = TRUE)

lay <- lay |>
    mutate(
        x = if_else(is_leaf, r * cos(angle * pi / 180), x),
        y = if_else(is_leaf, r * sin(angle * pi / 180), y),
        label_angle = if_else(angle > 90 & angle < 270, angle + 180, angle),
        hjust = if_else(angle > 90 & angle < 270, 1, 0)
    )

# Internal dataset group branches
grp_nodes <- lay |> filter(!is_leaf & str_starts(name, "dgroup::"))
if (nrow(grp_nodes) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(grp_nodes))) {
        nm <- grp_nodes$name[i]
        child_names <- lay |>
            filter(dataset_group == grp_nodes$dataset_group[i] & is_leaf) |>
            pull(name)
        child_angs <- lay |>
            filter(name %in% child_names) |>
            pull(angle)
        avg_ang <- mean(child_angs)

        r_branch <- r * 0.70
        lay$x[lay$name == nm] <- r_branch * cos(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay$y[lay$name == nm] <- r_branch * sin(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay$angle[lay$name == nm] <- avg_ang

        tangent_ang <- (avg_ang - 90) %% 360
        if (tangent_ang > 90 && tangent_ang < 270) tangent_ang <- tangent_ang - 180
        lay$label_angle[lay$name == nm] <- tangent_ang
        lay$hjust[lay$name == nm] <- 0.5
    }
}

# Input sub-branches
input_nodes <- lay |> filter(!is_leaf & str_starts(name, "type::"))
if (nrow(input_nodes) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(input_nodes))) {
        nm <- input_nodes$name[i]
        child_names <- lay |>
            filter(input_type == input_nodes$input_type[i] & is_leaf) |>
            pull(name)
        child_angs <- lay |>
            filter(name %in% child_names) |>
            pull(angle)
        avg_ang <- mean(child_angs)

        r_branch <- r * 0.70
        lay$x[lay$name == nm] <- r_branch * cos(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay$y[lay$name == nm] <- r_branch * sin(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay$angle[lay$name == nm] <- avg_ang

        tangent_ang <- (avg_ang - 90) %% 360
        if (tangent_ang > 90 && tangent_ang < 270) tangent_ang <- tangent_ang - 180
        lay$label_angle[lay$name == nm] <- tangent_ang
        lay$hjust[lay$name == nm] <- 0.5
    }
}

wideness <- r * 0.40
lay$x[lay$name == "branch::inputs"] <- wideness * cos(180 * pi / 180)
lay$y[lay$name == "branch::inputs"] <- 0
lay$x[lay$name == "branch::datasets"] <- wideness * cos(0 * pi / 180)
lay$y[lay$name == "branch::datasets"] <- 0

from_idx <- match(conn_edges$from, igraph::V(tg)$name)
to_idx <- match(conn_edges$to, igraph::V(tg)$name)

idx_remote <- which(conn_edges$input_type == "Remotely Sensed")
idx_stat <- which(conn_edges$input_type == "In Situ & Survey Data")
```

## Render Network Plot

```{r plot-network, fig.width=16, fig.height=14}
p <- ggraph(lay) +
    geom_conn_bundle(
        data = get_con(from = from_idx[idx_remote], to = to_idx[idx_remote]),
        color = bundle_palette["Remotely Sensed"], alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.7, tension = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_conn_bundle(
        data = get_con(from = from_idx[idx_stat], to = to_idx[idx_stat]),
        color = bundle_palette["In Situ & Survey Data"], alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.7, tension = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
        aes(filter = is_leaf, size = degree, color = I(node_color)),
        alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
        aes(
            x = r * 1.55 * cos(angle * pi / 180),
            y = r * 1.55 * sin(angle * pi / 180),
            filter = !is_leaf & (str_starts(name, "dgroup::") | str_starts(name, "type::")),
            label = label, angle = label_angle, hjust = hjust
        ),
        size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = bundle_palette["text_dark"], family = "sans"
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
        aes(
            x = x * 1.04, y = y * 1.04,
            filter = is_leaf & !is.na(pretty_label),
            label = pretty_label, angle = label_angle, hjust = hjust, color = I(node_color)
        ),
        size = 3.2, family = "sans", fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.0, 9.0), breaks = c(2, 5, 10, 20), name = "Connections") +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off", xlim = c(-1.85, 1.85), ylim = c(-1.85, 1.85)) +
    theme_publication()

p
```

## Experimental Network Plot (Grouped by inputGroup)

```{r experimental-network, fig.width=16, fig.height=14}
inputs_df <- read_excel(here("agri_data_review.xlsx"), sheet = "Inputs") |>
    select(source = inputName, inputGroup) |>
    distinct()

links_exp <- links |>
    left_join(inputs_df, by = "source") |>
    mutate(source = if_else(!is.na(inputGroup), inputGroup, source)) |>
    distinct(dataset, input_type, source, dataset_group)

source_nodes_exp <- links_exp |>
    distinct(input_type, source) |>
    arrange(input_type, source) |>
    mutate(
        node_id = paste0("src::", input_type, "::", source),
        label = source,
        node_kind = "source"
    )

dataset_nodes_exp <- links_exp |>
    distinct(dataset, dataset_group) |>
    arrange(dataset_group, dataset) |>
    mutate(
        node_id = paste0("ds::", dataset),
        label = dataset,
        node_kind = "dataset"
    )

conn_edges_exp <- links_exp |>
    left_join(source_nodes_exp |> select(input_type, source, from = node_id), by = c("input_type", "source")) |>
    left_join(dataset_nodes_exp |> select(dataset, to = node_id), by = "dataset") |>
    distinct(from, to, input_type)

hier_edges_exp <- list()
vertices_exp <- list()

vertices_exp[[1]] <- tibble(name = "branch::inputs", node_kind = "branch", input_type = NA_character_, dataset_group = NA_character_, label = "Inputs", is_leaf = FALSE)
vertices_exp[[2]] <- tibble(name = "branch::datasets", node_kind = "branch", input_type = NA_character_, dataset_group = NA_character_, label = "Datasets", is_leaf = FALSE)
hier_edges_exp[[1]] <- tibble(from = "branch::inputs", to = "branch::datasets")

dataset_groups_exp <- dataset_nodes_exp |>
    distinct(dataset_group) |>
    arrange(dataset_group) |>
    pull(dataset_group)

for (grp in dataset_groups_exp) {
    grp_id <- paste0("dgroup::", grp)
    vertices_exp[[length(vertices_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(name = grp_id, node_kind = "branch", input_type = NA_character_, dataset_group = grp, label = grp, is_leaf = FALSE)
    hier_edges_exp[[length(hier_edges_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(from = "branch::datasets", to = grp_id)

    grp_sets <- dataset_nodes_exp |> filter(dataset_group == grp)
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(grp_sets))) {
        hier_edges_exp[[length(hier_edges_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(from = grp_id, to = grp_sets$node_id[i])
        vertices_exp[[length(vertices_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(name = grp_sets$node_id[i], node_kind = "dataset", input_type = NA_character_, dataset_group = grp, label = grp_sets$label[i], is_leaf = TRUE)
    }
}

for (tp in c("Remotely Sensed", "In Situ & Survey Data")) {
    type_id <- paste0("type::", tp)
    vertices_exp[[length(vertices_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(name = type_id, node_kind = "branch", input_type = tp, dataset_group = NA_character_, label = tp, is_leaf = FALSE)
    hier_edges_exp[[length(hier_edges_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(from = "branch::inputs", to = type_id)

    type_sources <- source_nodes_exp |> filter(input_type == tp)
    if (nrow(type_sources) > 0) {
        for (i in seq_len(nrow(type_sources))) {
            hier_edges_exp[[length(hier_edges_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(from = type_id, to = type_sources$node_id[i])
            vertices_exp[[length(vertices_exp) + 1]] <- tibble(name = type_sources$node_id[i], node_kind = "source", input_type = tp, dataset_group = NA_character_, label = type_sources$label[i], is_leaf = TRUE)
        }
    }
}

hierarchy_exp <- bind_rows(hier_edges_exp)
vertices_df_exp <- bind_rows(vertices_exp) |> distinct(name, .keep_all = TRUE)

deg_tbl_exp <- tibble(name = c(conn_edges_exp$from, conn_edges_exp$to)) |> count(name, name = "degree")
vertices_df_exp <- vertices_df_exp |>
    left_join(deg_tbl_exp, by = "name") |>
    mutate(degree = replace_na(degree, 0L))

tg_exp <- tbl_graph(nodes = vertices_df_exp, edges = hierarchy_exp, directed = TRUE) |>
    activate(nodes) |>
    mutate(
        node_color = case_when(
            node_kind == "source" & input_type == "Remotely Sensed" ~ bundle_palette["Remotely Sensed"],
            node_kind == "source" & input_type == "In Situ & Survey Data" ~ bundle_palette["In Situ & Survey Data"],
            node_kind == "dataset" ~ pal_ds[dataset_group],
            TRUE ~ bundle_palette["node_default"]
        ),
        pretty_label = case_when(
            node_kind == "source" & degree >= MIN_LABEL_DEG_SOURCE ~ label,
            node_kind == "dataset" & degree >= MIN_LABEL_DEG_DATASET ~ label,
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
    )

lay_exp <- create_layout(tg_exp, layout = "dendrogram", circular = TRUE)
leaf_src_exp <- lay_exp |> filter(is_leaf & node_kind == "source")
leaf_ds_exp <- lay_exp |> filter(is_leaf & node_kind == "dataset")

lay_exp$angle <- NA_real_
lay_exp$angle[lay_exp$name %in% leaf_ds_exp$name] <- seq(80, -80, length.out = nrow(leaf_ds_exp))
lay_exp$angle[lay_exp$name %in% leaf_src_exp$name] <- seq(100, 260, length.out = nrow(leaf_src_exp))

r_exp <- max(sqrt(lay_exp$x^2 + lay_exp$y^2), na.rm = TRUE)

lay_exp <- lay_exp |>
    mutate(
        x = if_else(is_leaf, r_exp * cos(angle * pi / 180), x),
        y = if_else(is_leaf, r_exp * sin(angle * pi / 180), y),
        label_angle = if_else(angle > 90 & angle < 270, angle + 180, angle),
        hjust = if_else(angle > 90 & angle < 270, 1, 0)
    )

grp_nodes_exp <- lay_exp |> filter(!is_leaf & str_starts(name, "dgroup::"))
if (nrow(grp_nodes_exp) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(grp_nodes_exp))) {
        nm <- grp_nodes_exp$name[i]
        child_names <- lay_exp |>
            filter(dataset_group == grp_nodes_exp$dataset_group[i] & is_leaf) |>
            pull(name)
        child_angs <- lay_exp |>
            filter(name %in% child_names) |>
            pull(angle)
        avg_ang <- mean(child_angs)

        r_branch <- r_exp * 0.70
        lay_exp$x[lay_exp$name == nm] <- r_branch * cos(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay_exp$y[lay_exp$name == nm] <- r_branch * sin(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay_exp$angle[lay_exp$name == nm] <- avg_ang

        tangent_ang <- (avg_ang - 90) %% 360
        if (tangent_ang > 90 && tangent_ang < 270) tangent_ang <- tangent_ang - 180
        lay_exp$label_angle[lay_exp$name == nm] <- tangent_ang
        lay_exp$hjust[lay_exp$name == nm] <- 0.5
    }
}

input_nodes_exp <- lay_exp |> filter(!is_leaf & str_starts(name, "type::"))
if (nrow(input_nodes_exp) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(input_nodes_exp))) {
        nm <- input_nodes_exp$name[i]
        child_names <- lay_exp |>
            filter(input_type == input_nodes_exp$input_type[i] & is_leaf) |>
            pull(name)
        child_angs <- lay_exp |>
            filter(name %in% child_names) |>
            pull(angle)
        avg_ang <- mean(child_angs)

        r_branch <- r_exp * 0.70
        lay_exp$x[lay_exp$name == nm] <- r_branch * cos(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay_exp$y[lay_exp$name == nm] <- r_branch * sin(avg_ang * pi / 180)
        lay_exp$angle[lay_exp$name == nm] <- avg_ang

        tangent_ang <- (avg_ang - 90) %% 360
        if (tangent_ang > 90 && tangent_ang < 270) tangent_ang <- tangent_ang - 180
        lay_exp$label_angle[lay_exp$name == nm] <- tangent_ang
        lay_exp$hjust[lay_exp$name == nm] <- 0.5
    }
}

wideness_exp <- r_exp * 0.40
lay_exp$x[lay_exp$name == "branch::inputs"] <- wideness_exp * cos(180 * pi / 180)
lay_exp$y[lay_exp$name == "branch::inputs"] <- 0
lay_exp$x[lay_exp$name == "branch::datasets"] <- wideness_exp * cos(0 * pi / 180)
lay_exp$y[lay_exp$name == "branch::datasets"] <- 0

from_idx_exp <- match(conn_edges_exp$from, igraph::V(tg_exp)$name)
to_idx_exp <- match(conn_edges_exp$to, igraph::V(tg_exp)$name)
idx_remote_exp <- which(conn_edges_exp$input_type == "Remotely Sensed")
idx_stat_exp <- which(conn_edges_exp$input_type == "In Situ & Survey Data")

p_exp <- ggraph(lay_exp) +
    geom_conn_bundle(
        data = get_con(from = from_idx_exp[idx_remote_exp], to = to_idx_exp[idx_remote_exp]),
        color = bundle_palette["Remotely Sensed"], alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.7, tension = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_conn_bundle(
        data = get_con(from = from_idx_exp[idx_stat_exp], to = to_idx_exp[idx_stat_exp]),
        color = bundle_palette["In Situ & Survey Data"], alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.7, tension = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_node_point(
        aes(filter = is_leaf, size = degree, color = I(node_color)),
        alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
        aes(
            x = r_exp * 1.75 * cos(angle * pi / 180),
            y = r_exp * 1.75 * sin(angle * pi / 180),
            filter = !is_leaf & (str_starts(name, "dgroup::") | str_starts(name, "type::")),
            label = label, angle = label_angle, hjust = hjust
        ),
        size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = bundle_palette["text_dark"], family = "sans"
    ) +
    geom_node_text(
        aes(
            x = x * 1.04, y = y * 1.04,
            filter = is_leaf & !is.na(pretty_label),
            label = pretty_label, angle = label_angle, hjust = hjust, color = I(node_color)
        ),
        size = 3.2, family = "sans", fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2.0, 9.0), breaks = c(2, 5, 10, 20), name = "Connections") +
    coord_fixed(clip = "off", xlim = c(-1.85, 1.85), ylim = c(-1.85, 1.85)) +
    theme_publication()

p_exp
```

## Dataset Network Connectivity

```{r network-connectivity}
library(knitr)

raw_network <- read_excel(here("agri_data_review.xlsx"), sheet = "Sorted") |>
    mutate(nameShort = str_squish(nameShort)) |>
    filter(!is.na(nameShort), nameShort != "") |>
    select(target = nameShort, inputMap, inputRemote, inputStat) |>
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(inputMap, inputRemote, inputStat),
        names_to = "input_field",
        values_to = "source"
    ) |>
    filter(!is.na(source), source != "") |>
    separate_rows(source, sep = "[,;]") |>
    mutate(source = str_squish(source)) |>
    filter(source != "", source != "?") |>
    distinct(target, source, input_field)

out_degree <- raw_network |>
    count(source, name = "Out_Degree") |>
    arrange(desc(Out_Degree)) |>
    slice_head(n = 15)

kable(out_degree, caption = "Top 15 Most Connected Inputs (Highest Out-Degree)")

out_degree_grouped <- raw_network |>
    left_join(inputs_df, by = "source") |>
    mutate(source = if_else(!is.na(inputGroup), inputGroup, source)) |>
    count(source, name = "Out_Degree") |>
    arrange(desc(Out_Degree)) |>
    slice_head(n = 15)

kable(out_degree_grouped, caption = "Top 15 Most Connected Inputs (Grouped by Input Family)")

in_degree <- raw_network |>
    count(target, name = "In_Degree") |>
    arrange(desc(In_Degree)) |>
    slice_head(n = 15)

kable(in_degree, caption = "Top 15 Most Informed Datasets (Highest In-Degree)")
```

## Manuscript Figure Statistics

```{r manuscript-stats}
overall_proportions <- links |>
    group_by(input_type) |>
    summarise(Total_Links = n(), Unique_Sources = n_distinct(source)) |>
    mutate(Percentage_of_Links = round((Total_Links / sum(Total_Links)) * 100, 1))

kable(overall_proportions, caption = "Global Overview of Remote vs. Statistical Inputs")

source_importance <- links |>
    group_by(input_type, source) |>
    summarise(Datasets_Supported = n_distinct(dataset), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(Datasets_Supported)) |>
    slice_head(n = 15)

kable(source_importance, caption = "Top 15 Most Utilized Data Sources by Downstream Datasets")

source_importance_grouped <- links |>
    left_join(inputs_df, by = "source") |>
    mutate(source = if_else(!is.na(inputGroup), inputGroup, source)) |>
    group_by(input_type, source) |>
    summarise(Datasets_Supported = n_distinct(dataset), .groups = "drop") |>
    arrange(desc(Datasets_Supported)) |>
    slice_head(n = 15)

kable(source_importance_grouped, caption = "Top 15 Most Utilized Data Sources by Downstream Datasets (Grouped)")

median_inputs <- links |>
    count(dataset, name = "n_inputs") |>
    summarise(
        Median_Inputs = median(n_inputs),
        Mean_Inputs   = round(mean(n_inputs), 1),
        Max_Inputs    = max(n_inputs),
        Min_Inputs    = min(n_inputs)
    )

kable(median_inputs, caption = "Summary of Inputs per Dataset")

metric_proportions <- links |>
    group_by(dataset_group, input_type) |>
    summarise(Links = n(), .groups = "drop_last") |>
    mutate(
        Total_Metric_Links = sum(Links),
        Percentage = round((Links / Total_Metric_Links) * 100, 1)
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    arrange(dataset_group, input_type)

kable(metric_proportions, caption = "Proportion of Remote vs. Statistical Inputs per Metric")
```

## Visualize Input Proportions

```{r plot-metric-proportions, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
library(scales)

metric_order <- metric_proportions |>
    select(dataset_group, input_type, Percentage) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = input_type, values_from = Percentage, values_fill = 0) |>
    arrange(`Remotely Sensed`) |>
    pull(dataset_group)

p_prop <- metric_proportions |>
    mutate(
        dataset_group = factor(dataset_group, levels = metric_order),
        input_type = factor(input_type, levels = c("In Situ & Survey Data", "Remotely Sensed"))
    ) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = Percentage, y = dataset_group, fill = input_type)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.65) +
    scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("Remotely Sensed" = unname(bundle_palette["Remotely Sensed"]), "In Situ & Survey Data" = unname(bundle_palette["In Situ & Survey Data"])),
        name = "Input Type",
        breaks = c("Remotely Sensed", "In Situ & Survey Data")
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = "Percentage of Total Dataset Connections (%)", y = "") +
    theme_publication() +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(r = 10)),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.justification = "center",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.5),
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
    )

p_prop

ggsave(
    here("outputs", "figures", "metric_input_proportions.png"),
    p_prop,
    width = 8, height = 5, bg = "white"
)
```
